description: Origin airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of route-level grouping key

description: Destination airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of route-level grouping key
notes_or_concerns: Includes one unusual route, EWR to LGA, with a single cancelled flight

description: Number of flights observed for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Count of flight records grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Ranges from 1 to 11,262; 10 routes have fewer than 10 flights, so their averages are unstable

description: The Average Departure Delay for flights on the route
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of dep_delay grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Missing for EWR to LGA (its only flight was cancelled); negative values mean early departure on average

description: Average arrival delay for flights on the route, in minutes
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of arr_delay grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Missing for EWR to LGA (its only flight was cancelled); negative values mean early arrival on average

description: The Maximum Arrival Delay for flights on the route
transformation_or_derivation: Max of arr_delay grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Missing for EWR to LGA (its only flight was cancelled); extreme values should be reviewed

description: The Average Distance for flights on the route
transformation_or_derivation: The average distance grouped by origin and destination

description: The Average Air Time for flights on the route
transformation_or_derivation: The average air_time grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Measured in minutes; missing air_time values are excluded from the average

description: Full name of the destination airport
transformation_or_derivation: Joined from airports using dest = faa
notes_or_concerns: Missing for 7 routes whose destination (BQN, PSE, SJU, STT) is not in the airports table

description: The Latitude of the destination airport for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Joined from airports.lat using dest = faa
notes_or_concerns: Some routes have missing destination coordinates

description: The Longitude of the destination airport for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Joined from airports.lon using dest = faa
notes_or_concerns: Some routes have missing destination coordinates
